event.name: SPIEL Essen — Secret Garden sales (reserved time slots)

posts.text: Due to long queues and attendee safety SPIEL Essen requested we cancel Secret Garden sales for today. We've worked with SPIEL Essen to address concerns and are changing how Secret Garden purchases will be available. For the next three days, Secret Garden purchases use reserved time slots. Scan the QR code or use the link to sign up for a time slot…
